card.name: NSAID anemia sentence: "This may be"
card.fires_on: The words "may" or "be" in the sentence "This may be due to occult or gross blood loss", right after "Anemia has occurred in NSAID-treated patients" in a Hematologic Toxicity section.

modes.label: "be" after "This may"
modes.description: The word "be" in "This may be due to" following the NSAID anemia statement.
modes.example: Anemia has occurred in NSAID-treated patients. This may<< be>> due to occult or gross blood loss,

modes.label: "may" after "This"
modes.description: The word "may" in the same sentence, just before "be due to".
modes.example: Anemia has occurred in NSAID-treated patients. This<< may>> be due to occult or gross blood loss

card.plain: It lights up on the stock sentence saying NSAID-related anemia may be due to blood loss.
